title: Dapsone Gel 5% and Tretinoin Gel 0.025% Versus Tretinoin Gel 0.025% Monotherapy for Facial Acne Vulgaris
brief_summary: A 12-week evaluation of the safety and efficacy of dapsone gel 5% when used with tretinoin gel 0.025% compared with tretinoin gel 0.025% monotherapy in treating moderate to severe facial acne vulgaris
